rationale: Installation/package distribution can reasonably be labelled component/build, but no dedicated installer component exists. The exact install command npx install-electron is given with Electron 42.0.1, Node 26.1.0 and Debian. Unlike an isolated app API call, installation itself is the entire operation, so treating these terminal instructions as a sufficient reproduction is plausible. The frozen rubric also literally asks bug reports lacking a gist or runnable app for a sample; a paired need-repro request is therefore accepted without being mandatory. The extract-zip issue URL is not a runnable repository. Earlier install/cache/type examples do not have the same Node26 extraction failure. No upstream redirect: the reported extract-zip npm dependency failure does not establish a Chromium or Node-core defect. The external issue URL is not sufficient evidence for the rubric upstream category. Third-party app and support redirects also do not fit an Electron installer regression.
